🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -4.46% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND (fear easing) and Stocks vs Bonds (1W: +1.78% | 1M: +8.18%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND provide risk-on tilt while HYG (1W: -0.55% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.17% | 1M: -1.78%) BELOW TREND signal credit stress, producing mixed confirmations.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD showing weakness (Credit Spread level 0.7388, 1W: +0.42% | 1M: +1.01%) → flat | ABOVE TREND; Fear decreasing: VXX (1W: -4.46% | 1M: -6.14%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND; Stocks vs Bonds improving: SPY (1W: -0.09% | 1M: +4.01%) CORRECTION vs TLT (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -3.68%) BELOW TREND → net mixed.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tighter: Dollar strength (1W: +0.91% | 1M: +1.39%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND, yields (TLT (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -3.68%) BELOW TREND) pressure duration, while credit (HYG/LQD) flags stress — overall conditions neither plainly stimulative nor easing.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +5.96% | 1M: +10.11%) ABOVE TREND and XLE strength alongside USO (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +28.65%) ABOVE TREND; Tech mixed: XLK (1W: -1.98% | 1M: +12.96%) CORRECTION while Financials XLF (1W: +1.26% | 1M: -2.31%) RECOVERY — style: Financials/Energy showing relative strength vs Tech momentum under pressure.

5. US vs Global?
US marginally stronger: SPY (1W: -0.09% | 1M: +4.01%) CORRECTION; Emerging markets lag: EEM (1W: -4.30% | 1M: +2.09%) CORRECTION and FXI (1W: -3.50% | 1M: -3.83%) BELOW TREND, China weakness evident.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Waning: ARKK (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -6.33% | 1M: -0.93%) BELOW TREND signal lower speculative flows; IWM (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +0.07%) CORRECTION shows small‑cap caution.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity rally led by energy: USO (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +28.65%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +26.79%) ABOVE TREND; industrials/metal signals mixed with CPER (1W: -2.51% | 1M: +2.98%) CORRECTION and gold GLD (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -6.17%) BELOW TREND (profit taking).

8. Energy Trend?
Clear strength: XLE (1W: +5.96% | 1M: +10.11%) ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +2.85% | 1M: +6.46%) ABOVE TREND — energy is a dominant cyclical driver.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND) and commodity ETF leaders showing two‑frame positive confirmation. DIVERGENCE: MAJOR divergence across core risk ETFs — XLK (1W: -1.98% | 1M: +12.96%) CORRECTION, SOXX (1W: -6.92% | 1M: +19.28%) CORRECTION and QQQ (1W: -1.04% | 1M: +8.79%) CORRECTION — multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches suppress strong regime conviction.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposures showing confirmed strength (energy XLE (1W: +5.96% | 1M: +10.11%) ABOVE TREND, select financials XLF (1W: +1.26% | 1M: -2.31%) RECOVERY) and reduce exposure to speculative/volatile ETFs (ARKK, IBIT) while monitoring duration via TLT (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -3.68%) BELOW TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +5.96% | 1M: +10.11%) ABOVE TREND; Staples — XLP (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +5.85%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary — XLY (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -6.11%) BELOW TREND; Materials — XLB/Materials (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -2.76%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Oil — USO (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +28.65%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +26.79%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Gold — GLD (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -6.17%) BELOW TREND; Silver — SLV (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -5.01%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 27.20 — VXX (1W: -4.46% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND marks ongoing complacency when below this band; HYG/LQD ~0.74 (Credit Spread 0.7388, 1W: +0.42% | 1M: +1.01%) → flat is watch for widening stress; Tech vs Financials ratio ~3.37 (1W: -0.79% | 1M: +14.75%) CORRECTION is the rotation pivot to monitor.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive with mixed risk signals (VXX falling vs HYG/LQD weakness). Energy and select financials showing strength while MAJOR divergences across Tech/semis (XLK, SOXX, QQQ) are the key risk to monitor.
